Initial release of phy-security-headers: HTTP security header auditor.

- Audits HTTP response headers from any URL or local dev server.
- Grades headers against OWASP, Mozilla Observatory, and Google standards (A/B/C/F per header).
- Checks Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CORP/COEP/COOP.
- Detects common misconfigurations like unsafe-inline, wildcard sources, missing directives, weak HSTS, missing policies.
- Generates one-command server config fixes for nginx, Apache, Next.js, and Cloudflare Workers.
- Offers output tuning: grade only, choose config format, analyze any URL with a simple command.
- No external cloud dependencies; works locally using curl.
